security_class.span: issuing subscription rights to its common shareholders to purchase the Fund’s common shares

rights_per_share.span: Record Date Shareholders will receive one Right for each common share held on the Record Date

rights_per_new_share.span: For every three Rights held, you are entitled to purchase one new common share of the Fund

price_reference.span: formula equal to 85% of the reported net asset value or 95% of the market price per common share, whichever is higher on the Expiration Date

record_date.span: Fund is issuing transferable subscription Rights to its Common Shareholders of record as of May 25, 2021

expiration_date.span: Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., Eastern Time, on June 22, 2021

transferable.span: Rights are transferable and will be admitted for trading on the NYSE American under the symbol “GLQ RT”

over_subscription.span: Record Date Shareholders who fully exercise all Rights initially issued to them are entitled to buy those common shares, referred to as “Over-Subscription Shares,”

max_new_shares.span: subscribe for new common shares of the Fund in an aggregate amount of approximately 5,512,845 common shares

notes: Prospectus supplement dated May 21, 2021 (single document, seq=1). The subscription price is the higher of 85% of NAV and 95% of market, so price_reference is greater_of_nav_and_market. The two percentages cannot fill the single price_pct field, so it is null. The 14.41 estimated subscription price is the filing's May 14, 2021 estimate and is not a schema field. The expiration date is June 22, 2021 as stated, with no later extension in this excerpt. The excerpt is cut inside the fees table; nothing after the cut is used.
